description: Real-data soiling/snow screening illustration; not the thesis rasters
preprocessing: NASA POWER unadjusted AOD_55, explicit UTC daily dates, annual mean; no daily-curve averaging.
Open-Meteo explicit ERA5-Land physical snow depth in metres, converted to cm and summed hourly.
Complete UTC year per indicator and cell; no gap filling or partial-year annualization.
Nearest source samples at the requested grid centres; no area averaging or elevation downscaling.
NOAA-derived nearest land mask from the reviewed KGPV fixture; coarse coastal cells.
limitations: One year is a worked example, not a long-term climatological risk assessment.
NASA POWER and ERA5-Land replace the thesis's ECMWF aerosol/ERA5 inputs explicitly.
Source resolutions, aerosol biases and snow-depth overestimation affect results.
No independent field validation, cleaning model, or structural snow-load estimate.
